name: Lark Pikespeak
original_name: ラーク・パイクスピーク
source:
Lark Pikespeak is a famous hero and adventurer from the Keith Guild. He forms a team with [url=/c36802]Noah Sailing[/url], and they are well known as an impeccable duo. One of his greatest feats, along with Noah, was the defeat of a powerful Monster known as Kas A before.

He is a confident and powerful warrior, quite handsome and hard-working, but he's also pretty proud of himself and his skills. He's also been shown being pissed off over some situations with relatively ease, but he's not a bad person. He protected and fought to his best with his partner, always making sure to protect her from harm. 

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Lark_Pikespeak]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
